summary: Iter-33 refactor regression: Routers split into /app/backend/routers/*.py. Caught 4 real refactor regressions (missing imports in router files) during pytest; fixed them. After fixes: 36/36 backend tests pass, covering all 13 router modules + WS endpoint + 79 unique /api/* paths parity with pre-refactor server.py.bak. Frontend regression: Settings 'PUSH-УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ' section renders pending-admin text as expected (configured:false). Chat reply flow (reply-preview, msg-<id>, reply-<id>, delete-<id> testids) works correctly via inline reply button.

minor.issue: Accepts JSON body for DELETE (works but non-standard REST).
Returns 400 on empty body — fine, but consider explicit no-op validation message.

critical_code_review_comments: REGRESSION FIXED (was shipped broken): routers/files.py was missing `import uuid`, `import base64`, and `from server import _compress_image_data_url` — /api/files/upload would 500 on every image upload. Added imports.
REGRESSION FIXED: routers/auth.py was missing `from datetime import datetime, timezone` — login path for a user with `banned_until` set would raise NameError. Added imports.

REGRESSION FIXED: routers/demo.py was missing `from datetime import timedelta` — POST /api/demo/seed would NameError on first seed (second-call 'already' short-circuit happened to hide it). Added import.

LINT: routers/profile.py locally re-defined `_profile_completion` (which it also imports from server) — redundant shadow. Replaced the local def with a thin wrapper to avoid F811 and keep behaviour consistent with the authoritative definition in server.py.
Consider adding a smoke import test (`python -c 'import server; import routers.auth; ...'`) to CI to catch these NameErrors at startup instead of at first-request.

Pre-existing (unchanged by refactor): backend.err.log had a legacy `TypeError: await gout.close()` where gout is None — still present in routers/files.py get_file streaming path's finally block. Non-blocking (stream completes), but worth guarding.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Route parity: 79 unique /api/* paths = 83 route decorators (some paths have multi-method). Confirmed via diff of server.py.bak vs server.py+routers/*.py. The /api/openapi.json route doesn't exist (and never did pre-refactor) — docs live at /openapi.json, /docs, /redoc which go via FastAPI root, not under the /api APIRouter. WebSocket endpoint remains in server.py at /api/ws and responds to JSON {type:'ping'} with {type:'pong'}. Frontend uses localStorage key `lovreski_token` (not `token` or `auth_token`).
